judgments.supporting_quote:
Suction line leaks,
pump takes air
--- CELL ---
Find the leakage

Motor stalls
--- CELL ---
Fuses blown, check overload relay, stator and push buttons.

Piping stress at flanges/ pump in bind
--- CELL ---
Support piping properly

Cavitation (improper suction design)
--- CELL ---
Correct suction piping

Excess lubricant
--- CELL ---
Reduce quantity of grease, bearing should not be more
                                            than half full.

If the pump operates on a suction lift and no foot valve is provided; use a vacuum pump or
                 ejector operated by air, steam, water, etc., to evacuate air from the pump case and the
                 suction line

Discoloration
--- CELL ---
Balls and races darker than normal
appearance of bearing metal.

Motor fails to start
--- CELL ---
Check and reset overload in starter.
